name: scheduled-chat-continuation-gate
principle: Hourly survey-worker runs are work-conserving and normally finish only because their run-local time window reaches the handoff guard. Paper counts, discovery-round counts, candidate counts, submission counts, empty or duplicate-only rounds, exploration-space exhaustion claims, backlog shape, and job-local completion never authorize normal run finalization. Special runs such as maintenance and the 08:30 update worker keep their dedicated termination rules.

always_on_policy.overflow_research_rule: For the :00 discovery-specialist worker, candidate_inventory > 50 with actionable research/audit means switch to overflow research mode; large inventory is a mode switch, not a run stop.
always_on_policy.rule: Zero actionable paper stock, an empty round, a duplicate-only round, or an exhausted current query family means choose or refresh another independent discovery axis and continue until the time handoff guard.

scheduled_handoff_policy.rule: Capture the actual Scheduled Chat invocation start once and define run_deadline = actual_start + run_window_seconds. Before starting a new independent Research/Audit/discovery unit, recompute seconds_to_run_deadline and pass it to continuation_gate.py. At or below handoff_guard_seconds, do not start another independent unit; durably preserve current work and perform safe time-driven finalization. At or below hard_finalize_seconds, perform only minimum durable finalization. The nominal schedule boundary is a compatibility fallback only when the actual-start deadline cannot be established.

discovery_specialist_progression.rule: Discovery has no minimum quota, progression floor, fixed round target, fixed candidate target, fixed submission target, or candidate-count cap. Round and candidate counts are telemetry only. Outside the time handoff guard, refresh or change the search axis and continue even when the current exploration space appears exhausted.

research_blocked_retry_policy.rule: This is a per-paper retry policy, not a run-completion quota. Repeated paper-specific failure may become terminal for that paper while the worker continues other work until the run deadline.

fallback_policy.rule: GitHub is the canonical direct transport. If GitHub write is unavailable, ChatGPT Library is the only external durable outbox. Transport failure is an abnormal blocker when neither canonical nor fallback durable preservation is possible; it is not a successful normal run-stop reason.

backlog_policy.rule: Record-bank count, Library pending count, GitHub fallback-inbox count, candidate count, and unsent-paper count are telemetry/transport state, not run-completion quotas or discovery intake caps.

probe_success.action: checkpoint only the affected complete logical payload through ChatGPT Library fallback when direct GitHub write still cannot preserve it, leave its GitHub job incomplete, continue independent work, and allow later unrelated GitHub writes

probe_failure.action: disable further GitHub writes for the remainder of this run; checkpoint each completed payload through ChatGPT Library; continue independent work when durable fallback exists; otherwise preserve failure evidence as an abnormal blocker rather than report normal completion

fallback_failure_protocol.chatgpt_library_failed: if GitHub direct write can still durably preserve required state, continue through GitHub; otherwise preserve the failure as an abnormal blocker and do not report normal completion
fallback_failure_protocol.source_recovery_failed: leave the Library source pending and continue other research or GitHub-direct work; never treat one replay failure as a global normal stop
fallback_failure_protocol.dependency_not_materialized: leave the valid research/audit envelope in GitHub fallback-inbox until its deterministic canonical job is materialized; do not quarantine it merely for arriving before the offline seed
fallback_failure_protocol.duplicate_intake: if the same envelope id and content already exists in GitHub fallback-inbox/archive, acknowledge the Library copy without re-dispatching it
fallback_failure_protocol.id_conflict: quarantine only the conflicting envelope; do not overwrite the GitHub ledger and do not stop unrelated work

end_of_run_gate.rule: Before emitting a normal final response, apply scheduled_handoff_policy and continuation_gate.py. For hourly :00 discovery and :30 normal paper workers, only the time handoff guard authorizes normal STOP_RUN/finalization. Counts, quotas, exploration exhaustion, empty or duplicate-only discovery, no next-axis hint, successful submission, completed jobs, or backlog state never authorize normal finalization. If an axis is exhausted, broaden or change the axis and continue. Platform/read/durable-save failures are abnormal blockers and must not be converted into a normal-success finalization permit. Maintenance and the 08:30 update worker retain their dedicated rules.
